plugins.name: ai
plugins.description: Skills for building with LLMs and designing for agents — prompt architecture, agent interface design (UI/UX/CLI/tools), multi-agent orchestration, LLM output quality, and agentic testing.

plugins.name: claude-authoring
plugins.description: Guides for authoring Claude Code artifacts — CLAUDE.md files, hooks, rules, skills, commands, and scripts.

plugins.name: knowledge-capture
plugins.description: Skills for capturing knowledge through interviews, peer collaboration, breakthrough thinking, and session takeaways.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Knowledge for web development workflows — frontend product design and UX consultancy.

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Work with Cloudflare from a shell — Wrangler + curl against the REST API, endpoint discovery from the OpenAPI spec, and the llms.txt doc index. The Code Mode pattern without MCP.

plugins.name: design-discovery
plugins.description: Socratic, crtr human-led design-discovery interviews — grill the user to shape the ideal product experience and to extract and pressure-test the technical design before building.

plugins.name: vercel
plugins.description: Work with Vercel from a shell — Vercel CLI for deploy/dev/logs, REST API access with Bearer tokens, and docs discovery through Vercel's llms.txt and references.

plugins.name: railway
plugins.description: Work with Railway from a shell — Railway CLI for deploy/logs/environments, GraphQL API access with project or account tokens, and docs discovery through Railway's llms.txt and markdown references.

plugins.name: fly
plugins.description: Work with Fly.io from a shell — flyctl for launch/deploy/status/logs, Machines API access with Bearer tokens, and reference discovery through Fly.io docs, flyctl help, and Machines API docs.

plugins.name: capture
plugins.description: Mounts `crtr capture` as a transparent passthrough to the external Capture CLI (@crouton-kit/capture) — CDP screenshots, measurement, HAR, a11y, JS-exec, and site libs.

plugins.name: search
plugins.description: Mounts `crtr search` — web search, grounded cited answers, and clean content extraction through the Exa API, using a locally resolved key (EXA_API_KEY or ~/.crouter/exa.key).

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Provides the stable `dev` front door plus runbooks for creating Grove-backed development workflows.
